raw_html: [[Thunderbane]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Thunderbane]]:''' This weapon was crafted in the great [[Thunderforge]] before the Dragons came. Against [[construct]]s and the [[undead]], this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +8 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 7 to 42 points of damage against the foes.
